# Team Combat

INTEGRATED SYSTEM: this skill belongs to the complete "Claude Code Game Studios" template (49 agents, 74 skills, templates and a studio CLAUDE.md); it assumes that template and its conventions. This listing installs only this skill's folder, without the rest of the system, and the skill may reference template agents or files that are absent outside the full template. It orchestrates the combat team for one feature: a game-designer drafts the GDD (the orchestrator writes design/gdd/[feature].md only after asking), an architecture sketch is validated by the engine specialist, gameplay, AI, VFX and sound agents implement in parallel, and a qa-tester validates with test cases and bug files. At the default team size the gameplay-programmer runs alone; small runs the full team, studio adds engine sub-specialists and an adversarial QA pass. Drafts and QA artifacts are written under production/, docs/ or tests/ under a documented bounded exception; code, VFX and shader files need one ask for the whole set.
